key_sections.name: Фиксирана Навигация (Header)
key_sections.details: Dark translucent header with muted light links, cyan logo/CTA, subtle charcoal border. Navigation: Услуги, Проекти, За мен, Контакти, AI assistant. Compact menu below 1024px.

key_sections.name: Начална Секция (Hero)
key_sections.details: Kinetic entrance animation using framer-motion. Displays 'Гюрсел Исмаилов' in high-impact typography, status badge '🟢 Наличен за нови проекти', clear subheadline detailing specialized mobile & web development, fast statistics counter (5+ г. опит, 30+ завършени проекта, 100% клиентско удовлетворение), and dual CTA buttons.

key_sections.name: Кинетична Текстова Лента (Tech Ticker)
key_sections.details: Infinite moving tech stack ribbon highlighting core capabilities: Android • iOS • React • Swift • Kotlin • FastAPI • Tailwind • SwiftUI • Jetpack Compose • REST & GraphQL APIs • Node.js • MongoDB.

key_sections.name: Секция Услуги (Bento Grid Services)
key_sections.details: Bento layout with 3 key pillars: 1. Android Разработка (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3, Play Store publishing), 2. iOS Разработка (Swift, SwiftUI, iOS Architecture, App Store review compliance), 3. Уеб Сайтове & Уеб Приложения (React, Next.js, Tailwind, Fast Backend Integration, SEO Optimization). Plus Full-Stack integration card.

key_sections.name: Портфолио & Избрани Проекти (Portfolio)
key_sections.details: Interactive project showcase with filtering by category (Всички, Android, iOS, Уеб). Each project card features real mockups, live preview modal, key metrics, architecture tech badges, GitHub/Live links, and case study detail popup.

key_sections.name: За мен & Опит (About & Skills)
key_sections.details: Story of Гюрсел Исмаилов, core development values (чист код, бързина, мобилна оптимизация), timeline of experience, and interactive skill bars (Android SDK, Swift/iOS, React/JS, Backend/APIs, Database Design, UI/UX Implementation).

key_sections.name: AI Чат Асистент на Гюрсел (Claude)
key_sections.details: Dark floating assistant with cyan user bubbles (dark text), dark raised assistant bubbles (white text), streamed Claude responses in Bulgarian. Keep existing backend integration.

key_sections.name: Контактна Форма & Данни (Contact Section)
key_sections.details: Working contact form submitting directly to backend endpoint `/api/contact` (saved to MongoDB). Fields: Име, Имейл, Телефон, Тип проект (Android / iOS / Уеб / Комплексен проект), Бюджет, Описание на проекта. Includes interactive validation and Sonner toast notification. Also displays direct contact badges (Имейл, Телефон, Локация: София / България).

key_sections.name: Футер (Footer)
key_sections.details: Editorial Swiss-style footer with oversized 'ГЮРСЕЛ ИСМАИЛОВ' typography, quick navigation links, social profile links (LinkedIn, GitHub, Email, Telegram), and copyright.

motion_and_interactions.animations: Preserve line reveals, card lift with subtle cyan borders, Lenis smooth scrolling, and backdrop-blur dialogs. No blue/purple decorative orbs.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Button active scale (whileTap 0.98), hover lift (-translate-y-1), pulse ring on availability status badge

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, tabs, links, modals, chat toggle) MUST include descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='contact-form-submit-button', data-testid='ai-chat-toggle-button', data-testid='portfolio-filter-android')
testing_and_accessibility.cyrillic_rendering: Ensure standard UTF-8 encodings and proper font loading for Cyrillic characters in Bulgarian

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Bulgarian portfolio for Гюрсел Исмаилов matching the user's DARK reference screenshot.
Use near-black #0B1216 canvas, charcoal surfaces, white and readable grey text, cyan #59D5F5 accents. Buttons use dark text on cyan. No light UI panels or royal-blue accents.
Ensure explicit data-testid attributes are present on every interactive element and form field.
Hook up the contact form to the Python FastAPI backend endpoint (/api/contact) which persists inquiries in MongoDB and triggers Sonner toasts.
Preserve the existing Claude AI Chat Widget and Bulgarian responses.
Preserve existing Cyrillic Unbounded/Manrope typography and use the user's own supplied portrait in the hero.
